name: two circles converge, then a numbered order steps in
looks: Two solid circles, one for intelligence and one for production craft, slide together until their edges overlap, and the lens where they meet fills with a dense, noisy texture, captioned as the exact fit between the two. The circles cut away to a claim about the right order, and a run of numbered circles pops in one at a time, first one, then two, then three, each labelled for its stage in the process.
build: The venn-overlap-converge mechanic for the first half: two DOM/SVG circles translate together on power2.inOut, their intersection a clipped layer filled with a seeded stipple pattern. The numbered sequence hard-cuts a new coloured circle with its digit and label on each beat, each earlier circle staying on screen as the run builds left to right (the list-stack-reveal mechanic adapted to circles instead of lines).
sound: A soft converging whoosh and a grain-like rattle as the circles meet, then a tick per number as the sequence builds.
prompt: Slide two labelled, solid-coloured circles together until they overlap, filling the lens where they meet with its own distinct texture rather than a plain blend, caption it as a precise fit, then cut to a short run of numbered circles popping in one at a time, left to right, each one staying on screen as the next lands, to show the right order of steps.
